test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

This fact has not been brought to my notice by anybody.

options.text: Nobody brought this fact to my notice.
My notice has not been brought to this fact.
Anybody has not brought this fact to my notice.
Nobody has brought this fact to my notice.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Nobody has brought this fact to my notice."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The basic structure of these types of sentences:

 
 
• ​The construction of Active Voice here is –

 **Subject + has / have + Verb****3 ****Object**

 The construction of Passive Voice here is –

 **Subject****1 ****+ has / have + been + Verb****3 ****+ (by + agent)**

 **Example**:

 Active: Seema has bought a car. 

 Subject has Verb3 Object

 Passive: A car has been bought by Seema.
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct answer is: *Nobody has brought this fact to my notice.*
